scope: Proposed measurable beta acceptance targets, not service promises. Review with accountable operations lead before real beta. Dedicated representative staging required for capacity results.

authenticated-api-p95.unit: ms at 20 concurrent members over 15 minutes

approved-video-start-p95.unit: ms for rights-cleared low-data video on supported devices

urgent-human-response-p95.unit: minutes during declared staffed hours; outside-hours gaps separately reported

accessible-core-task-completion.unit: percent of consented participant attempts without critical help

backlog-oldest-urgent.unit: minutes under a 100 ordinary / 10 urgent synthetic-report staging burst

restore-rpo.unit: hours of data loss, subject to verified provider capability

restore-rto.unit: hours until validated isolated restore and revocation replay
